notes: Field-sampled: the surface itself carries no undercut at this parting.
Judged with the ring as built: 4 CAD parts (1 joined, 3 cut) at the parting plane z = +0.00 mm — 1981.2 mm² of part surface, 238.2 mm² of it undercut.

Extrude "Raise the flange along the band's high edge" (#4): 226.6 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on its drag-facing flank above the parting plane, 220–220°, 0.9–1.2 mm toward the high edge — stage it Bench to solder it on after the pour (the pattern keeps a locating mark), or move it onto the parting line.

Extrude "Pierce the bay through the flange and the band" (#9): 0.4 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on the hole's walls facing down above the parting plane, 94–99°, 1.2–1.2 mm toward the high edge — drill it at the bench: stage it Bench and the pattern keeps a raised drill mark at its centre.

Ring array "Wheel the bay round the finger" (#10): 11.1 mm² of undercut leaning to -90° on the hole's walls facing down above the parting plane, 110–84°, 1.0–1.2 mm toward the high edge — drill it at the bench: stage it Bench and the pattern keeps a raised drill mark at its centre.
With its CAD parts 45.7% of the ring carries less than 3.0 deg of draft or stands parallel to the pull — it releases, but drags on the sand.

summary: 6 x 3 band with one 2.4 mm flange on its high edge running out to r 16.2 (6.9 mm of radial run); the wheel is 24 lancets on 0.9 mm spokes and 24 quatrefoils between hub and rim mouldings, pierced through.
